findings.source_quote: She was treated with olanzapine and later with fluphenazine decanoate when she was irregular with medications.
findings.explanation: The note associates medication irregularity with the later fluphenazine decanoate course; it does not state that irregularity was a reaction to olanzapine. This treatment-response linkage is unsupported.

findings.source_quote: She was a known case of schizophrenia on treatment under psychiatry for the past 10 years.
